rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for moving rhythmically to music.

example.english: I used to dance all the time when I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tiu3 mou5

rows.note: Use 舞 as the all-purpose noun for a particular dance or dance routine.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tiu3 ni1 zek3 mou5

rows.note: Use 舞蹈 for dance as an art or field of study, or for a formal description of dancing.

example.english: Dance is an art that combines music and bodily movement.
example.traditional: 舞蹈係一種結合音樂同身體動作嘅藝術。
example.jyutping: mou5 dou6 hai6 jat1 zung2 git3 hap6 jam1 ngok6 tung4 san1 tai2 dung6 zok3 ge3 ngai6 seot6

rows.note: Use 舞會 for a social event or party where dancing is the main activity.

example.english: The dance tonight is really lively.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go2 go3 mou5 wui6 hou2 jit6 naau6
